name: Freebirds World Burrito
blurb: 879 Embarcadero del Norte — the big burrito spot where I.V. meets for lunch and late-night runs.

name: I.V. Deli Mart
blurb: 6553 Pardall Road — the corner store everyone knows for snacks, drinks, and late-night stops.

name: Pardall Tunnel
blurb: The foot tunnel under Highway 217 at Pardall — painted walls and the walk between I.V. and UCSB.

name: Embarcadero Hall
blurb: 935 Embarcadero del Norte — a UCSB-owned student hub and landmark building in the heart of I.V.

name: Perfect Park
blurb: Small park at Embarcadero del Norte and Pardall — benches, trees, and a classic meet-up spot.

name: Super Cuca's
blurb: 6527 Madrid Road — local Mexican burritos and tacos, a few steps off Embarcadero del Norte.
